blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The unavailability of generating units at three major coal-fired power plants in the Visayas continues to result in low capacity, prompting a yellow alert for the grid from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Friday. The National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) estimated the grid’s available capacity at 2,565 megawatts (MW), which is inadequate to meet contingency requirements as peak demand is forecast to reach 2,456 MW.
